title: Astrid and the Signal
author: Elodie Villalobos
blurb: Cyrus Crane, an insurance investigator of impossible accidents, has spent seven years hauling cargo through contested orbits. But when the colony's children start sharing the same dream, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must keep a lie alive that holds two fleets apart, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
